name: sol_basics_vi_svi_9
description: Yul optimizer bug removing memory writes in multi-assembly-block functions (Solidity 0.8.13-0.8.14)
question: The Solidity source file in `source` declares pragma solidity version 0.8.13 or 0.8.14 and contains a function with two or more separate inline assembly blocks that perform memory writes without referencing any Solidity variables, making it vulnerable to the Yul optimizer incorrectly eliminating those memory writes; this excludes files using a pragma outside 0.8.13-0.8.14, files with only a single inline assembly block per function, or blocks that reference Solidity variables directly.
criteria: A function pragma-locked to 0.8.13 or 0.8.14 has two inline assembly blocks, each using mstore to write to the same memory location, with no Solidity variable referenced inside either block
A function contains three sequential assembly{...} blocks manipulating raw memory pointers via mstore/mload without touching any named Solidity variable, compiled under pragma 0.8.13

A helper function under pragma 0.8.14 has one assembly block that writes returndata to memory and a second separate assembly block that reads from that same memory offset, with no Solidity-level variable used in either block
